description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingPreconditionFailedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when a precondition header validation fails for a Thing or its sub-entities. It includes builder support for creating instances with detailed context and methods for constructing from JSON data.

classes.name: ThingPreconditionFailedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a precondition check on a Thing resource has failed. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, with static methods for creation and JSON deserialization, and an inner builder class.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance for constructing a ThingPreconditionFailedException with specified header name, expected, and actual values.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance of ThingPreconditionFailedException from a JSON object and associated headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the provided DittoHeaders, preserving other attributes.
